item.title: Flash Floods and Landslides in Kathmandu, Nepal
item.description: Severe flash flooding and landslides reported across Kathmandu valley after torrential rains.
item.content:encoded: Heavy inundation and landslide warnings issued by Nepal DHM authorities for Bagmati river basin.

item.title: Cyclone Alert: Severe Cyclonic Storm in Bay of Bengal approaching Odisha coast
item.description: Tropical cyclone intensifying over Bay of Bengal, expected to make landfall near Odisha, India.

item.title: Heatwave Advisory for Uttar Pradesh and Bihar
item.description: Scorching heatwave conditions prevail over Lucknow and Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.
